bullets.title: TSM: Record Q2 Revenue Beat but Stock Drops; AI Cycle Broadening
bullets.body: TSMC reported Q2 revenue of $39.9B (+25% YoY from $31.9B), achieving its fourth consecutive 'triple play' (revenue, operating income, net income beats) and seventh in two years, yet stock fell ~4% premarket. Company raised full-year revenue and capex guidance; HPC represents 66% of platform revenue. Key read-through: AI investment cycle is broadening from accelerator-focused to full-stack infrastructure, and TSMC gross margin printed a remarkable 67.7%.

bullets.title: NVDA: Jensen Says AI Boom 'In Early Stages'; Japan Builds National AI Factory with Rubin GPUs
bullets.body: Jensen Huang declared 'we are at the beginning of the cycle' in Tokyo, where he met with Sega executives. Japan is constructing the world's first national AI factory using 27,500 Nvidia Rubin GPUs and 13,750 Vera CPUs with 140 MW capacity. NVDA was outperforming peers while many large-cap semis fell below their 50-day moving averages, but was down 1.5% premarket on the broader tech selloff.

bullets.title: GOOGL: EU Forces Android/Search Open to Rivals; Intel Partnership; Massive Call Flow
bullets.body: EU antitrust ruling orders Google to open Android and Search to competitors in a structurally enforceable mandate—a meaningful threat to its European competitive moat. Separately, Intel and Google Cloud expanded their multi-year strategic partnership to deploy Gemini Enterprise across Intel's enterprise. Options desks flagged tens of millions in GOOGL call flow, and GOOGL was up 1.3% premarket. Google also rebranded NotebookLM to Gemini Notebook and is prepping a Gemini avatar feature.

bullets.title: NFLX: Bears in Control Heading Into Q2 Earnings Tonight
bullets.body: Investors are positioned bearishly ahead of Netflix's Q2 2026 earnings report tonight, citing engagement headwinds. Bespoke notes NFLX has fallen after each of its last four earnings reports, including -9.7% after April results and -5.1% a year ago in July. Sentiment skews negative into the print.

bullets.title: Semis Broadly Weak: SOX Down 5%, MRVL -31% and AAOI -50% This Month
bullets.body: The semiconductor index fell another 5% today, breaking below initial May highs, though still up 53% YTD. MRVL is down 31% and AAOI down 50% this month alone, with the AI sector declining indiscriminately across higher-beta names. Goldman cut global PC shipment forecasts citing a memory chip crunch derailing upgrade cycles. Nasdaq gained 0.5%+ yesterday even as SOX fell 2%+—a rare divergence since 2010.

bullets.title: MU: Down ~19% Since Burry Short; Drops 5.4% Despite QCOM Memory LTA Signing
bullets.body: Micron fell 5.37% today despite announcing long-term supply agreements with Qualcomm, raising questions about whether declines reflect broader market headwinds rather than company fundamentals. MU is now down roughly 19% since Michael Burry established his short position.

bullets.title: ORCL: Down 50% Since June; Seen as Leveraged Bearish Play on OpenAI Exposure
bullets.body: Oracle has declined approximately 50% since June as investors view it as a leveraged negative on the Oracle-OpenAI partnership amid broader AI stock concerns, even as OpenAI's private valuation has risen. One trader flagged ORCL chart patterns beginning to resemble those forming in space and chip stocks—a potentially constructive technical signal.

bullets.title: AAPL: Trader Sells Shares Citing 'Too Good to Be True'; OLED iPad Mini Confirmed for 2027; Large Call Flow
bullets.body: One active trader sold AAPL shares citing skepticism over recent outperformance ('too good to be true lately'). Bloomberg confirmed Apple is readying an OLED iPad Mini with low-end and Air model updates in 2027. Tens of millions in AAPL call flow was flagged by options desks. One analyst also notes AAPL-AVGO pricing power dynamics are shifting as custom silicon complexity grows.

bullets.title: TSLA: FSD Crash Details; Humanoid Lag vs China; Cybercab Unit Economics Modeled
bullets.body: Investigators confirmed a fatal Texas Tesla FSD crash involved the driver pressing the accelerator 100%, overriding the system. Separately, critics argue Tesla is reluctant to showcase its latest humanoid prototypes while Chinese competitors advance publicly. One analyst models Cybercab at ~$2,500 pretax profit per unit per quarter at scale.

bullets.title: LITE & COHR: Morgan Stanley Names Both as Core CPO Laser Players; LITE TAM Expanded 9x to $154B
bullets.body: Morgan Stanley identified LITE and COHR as core coherent photonics/CPO laser players in a recent note, with Fidelity Research and JP Morgan taking active positions. LITE's historical playbook—growing from $3B to $60B+ by owning the EML chokepoint—is cited as a precedent, with Goldman estimating LITE's TAM expanded 9x to ~$154B by H2 2028.

bullets.title: MRVL: Sub-THz Wireless Demo at 153 Gb/s Validates Data Center Interconnect Roadmap
bullets.body: Marvell's acquired Polariton unit demonstrated a 226 GHz sub-terahertz wireless link over 1,400 meters at 153 Gb/s in a Swiss airfield test alongside ETH Zurich, validating its data center interconnect technology roadmap. The demo is seen as credentialing Marvell's DCI ambitions.

bullets.title: ARM: S&P Upgrades SoftBank Outlook to Stable, Citing ARM Stock Appreciation
bullets.body: S&P Global revised SoftBank's credit outlook from negative to stable, explicitly citing the rise in ARM's stock price as a key credit positive; SoftBank's BB+ rating was reaffirmed.

bullets.title: GOOGL/INTC: Agentic AI Drives Additive Server-CPU Cycle Benefiting AMD, ARM, Intel
bullets.body: A research note argues agentic AI is creating additive demand for server CPUs alongside GPU workloads—not a substitution—benefiting AMD, ARM, and Intel. TSMC's Q2 earnings call read-throughs confirm AI investment broadening beyond accelerators into full infrastructure build-out, which supports this thesis.

bullets.title: RBLX: Launches AI-Powered Mobile Game Creation
bullets.body: Roblox will let users create games using AI on their phones, aiming to lower the barrier to game development for casual creators. No financial figures were provided but the feature expands Roblox's creator ecosystem.

bullets.title: HOOD: Robinhood Chain Breaks Out, Volume Surpasses Major Crypto DEXs
bullets.body: Fundstrat notes Robinhood's Chain product experienced a massive breakout, with volume exceeding many established decentralized exchanges. The development signals growing traction for Robinhood's crypto infrastructure ambitions.

bullets.title: WBD: Prediction Markets Shrug Off California Lawsuit Against Paramount-WBD Merger
bullets.body: California filed a lawsuit challenging the David Ellison-led Paramount-WBD merger, but prediction markets are pricing in minimal impact from the legal challenge.

bullets.title: Mag 7 Diverges from SOX; GOOGL/MSFT +1.3%, NVDA -1.5% Premarket
bullets.body: Premarket action showed clear divergence within the Mag 7: Alphabet and Microsoft each +1.3%, Amazon +0.7%, Apple +0.4%, Meta +0.3%, while Tesla was -0.2% and Nvidia -1.5%. The broader pattern of Mag 7 rising while SOX falls was flagged by Goldman traders, who also cited potential CAPEX cut announcements ahead.
